name: tracker-native-alert-host-work
goal: Managed Tracker sessions resolve the active installed CLI for alert and host-work after an upgrade.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Run 1275 on primary Mac reproduced unavailable in native mode for alert and host-work; removing the inherited executable pin reached both live parsers. The configured tools symlink and pinned binary point to different releases.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing managed-worker roundtrip uses a regular harness fixture and does not invoke the installed Tracker shim with the launched environment. Exercise the same lifecycle with a CLI symlink rotated across fixture releases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red checkpoint f532d920fd: both shim commands returned exit 1 and command is unavailable in native mode after activation of the fixture CLI.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Retain startup executable validation and pass the configured tools/harness path to workers so each invocation resolves the active symlink.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged managed-worker roundtrip passed on 3c91c22d33 against red 608d4b6b38. The real shim selected the fixture active CLI for both alert and host-work after symlink replacement.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
Check other Tracker executable pins and deployment entrypoints.
